figurative_meaning_bn: সব ব্যাপার, সব বিষয় ও সব কিছু
figurative_meaning_en: all matters, all subjects, and everything
example_sentences_in_bangla: চতুর্দিক বিচার করে সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়া উচিত।
example_sentences_in_english: One should decide after considering all around.
He took into account the situation all around.
note: The idiom draws from spatial awareness in Bengali language, emphasizing thoroughness.
